packageRules.description: Harness: everything that isn't a candidate, in one PR a month, merged by hand. A new Playwright brings a new Chromium and a new Bun a new harness, so each of these changes the rig.
Candidates: a release line moves to its newest stable release once that release is 7 days old, and the PR merges itself when CI passes. Nothing is measured until a fleet run is dispatched.
MapLibre 5 is a closed line: it never leaves 5.x.
A new MapLibre major is a new release line, added by hand as a new alias. The dashboard lists it. Approving it there would move the maplibre-gl-6 line to the new major, so don't.
mapbox-gl stays at 1.13.3: Mapbox's terms forbid benchmarking later releases against a substitute (docs/adr/0001).
